scope_map.approval_scope: scope framework only; it does not accept sources, topics, or country completion

policy: Coverage is issue-led and separate from source acceptance. Evidence points to accepted local legal text, official reference notes, or guidance/form notes and labels the representation. An official URL, EWR Register entry, source-reference note, or dynamic form is not by itself retained legal text. A pathway remains incomplete until the applicable EEA measure/adaptation, Liechtenstein publication and effective date, national legal text, route-specific procedure and remedies are mapped. Acceptance of local legal text does not accept a FreeMovement topic.

topics.label: Access blocked before formal lodging

evidence.representation: accepted local PFZG and PFZV legal-text copies; version/date and Liechtenstein-specific EEA adaptations remain relevant
accepted local EEA decision text and national EEA implementation/publication law; current JCD 191/1999 effect is not established by the historical decision alone

layers.open_gap: No complete provision map identifies formal lodging, appointment prerequisites, refusal to accept an application, responsible authority, or the current EEA special-solution conditions. JCD 191/1999 contains conditional and transitional wording; its current status and later amendments need confirmation from the Liechtenstein Gazette/EWR Register.

evidence.representation: accepted local PFZV, ZAV and VEV legal-text copies, with distinct EEA/Swiss, third-country and Schengen roles

layers.open_gap: Reconcile the current PFZV text with the EWR Register and Gazette, map any route-specific entry/lodging rules, and distinguish EEA/Swiss permits from third-country and Schengen visa rules.

evidence.representation: official first-step online family-reunification form map and visa/representation guidance note; later form screens are not verified

layers.open_gap: The form note maps only the verified initial step. Current appointment, territorial responsibility, submission method, required evidence, accessibility, accommodation and service-provider steps remain unverified.

evidence.representation: accepted local general administrative-procedure law plus official court and limited legal-advice reference notes

layers.open_gap: No decision-specific route connects blocked intake to a reviewable decision, reasons, administrative appeal, court, deadline, urgent relief and legal aid.

topics.open_gap: Identify the deciding authority and route (EEA, Swiss, ordinary Schengen, or third-country) and distinguish a service/appointment barrier from refusal to accept a formal application.

topics.label: Digital-only or service-provider access requirement

layers.open_gap: No mapped statutory provision establishes a digital-only requirement, a duty to offer an alternative, or the legal status of the online form as the exclusive channel.
Accessibility, assisted filing, exceptions, delegation and service-provider rules have not been mapped to a current official text.

evidence.representation: official interactive form and visa-guidance reference notes; form note verifies the initial screen only

layers.open_gap: Later form screens, account/identity prerequisites, alternatives, assistance, service providers, and failure-handling are not recorded.
No verified remedy or accommodation route is linked to digital exclusion or a failed online application.

topics.open_gap: The online form is an operational lead, not proof of a digital-only legal rule or a complete application route.

topics.label: EU-family proof and ordinary Schengen checklist

evidence.representation: accepted local JCD 191/1999, EEA implementation law and PFZG text; JCD 158/2007/Directive 2004/38 is identified by the official EEA register route but not retained as a Liechtenstein-adapted text here
accepted EFTA-hosted Swiss/Liechtenstein protocol copy; its present legal status was not independently established

layers.open_gap: PFZG Article 1 identifies Directive 2004/38, the special EEA solution and a Swiss framework; map the EEA adaptation, current special conditions, family/partner/other-beneficiary categories and current protocol status. Do not infer identical EU, EEA and Swiss regimes.

evidence.representation: accepted local PFZV, AuG, ZAV and VEV texts; their routes and source versions differ

layers.open_gap: PFZV's checked consolidation is dated 2024; verify current amendments, Gazettes and EEA adaptations before treating its procedures or documentary list as current.

evidence.representation: bilateral visa-framework locator, first-step online form map and official visa/representation guidance; the treaty is not copied and later form screens are unverified

layers.open_gap: Map civil-status and relationship proof, translation/authentication, family route, representation agreement, exact checklist and competent mission. Separate the ordinary Schengen checklist from EEA-family facilitation.

evidence.representation: accepted general procedure law and official court/legal-advice references

layers.open_gap: No person/category- and decision-specific review route for denial of a document, visa, residence permit or family-reunification application is complete.

topics.open_gap: Map EEA-incorporated rights, Liechtenstein's special solution, Schengen short-stay rules, third-country national rules and the separate Swiss route by person category and document type.

topics.label: Complaint, appeal, or review-path information

evidence.representation: accepted local LVG administrative-procedure and appeals text; date and cross-references must be checked against authentic Gazette publication

layers.open_gap: The special immigration/EEA and Schengen appeal provisions and their priority over general procedure are not mapped by decision type.
Current service, reasons, notification and appeal-time rules for visa, free-movement, residence and digital-form decisions are not cross-referenced.

evidence.representation: official court, data-protection complaint and limited legal-advice service reference notes

layers.open_gap: General portals and help pages do not establish standing, authority, stage, deadline, interim effect, or remedy for a particular immigration decision.

evidence.representation: accepted local general procedure statute plus official court and legal-advice references

layers.open_gap: Build the authority-to-complaint-to-administrative/judicial review path, including reasons, deadlines, urgent relief and legal aid, from current official texts.

topics.open_gap: No complete decision-specific remedy map is accepted; the LVG and guidance sources do not by themselves establish a route for each immigration, visa, data or EEA decision.

topics.label: Appointment access and processing clock

evidence.representation: accepted legal texts contain residence/visa application procedures but are not mapped to a complete clock

layers.open_gap: No route-specific map identifies the legally relevant filing/receipt event, deadline, suspension, extension or decision period.

evidence.representation: accepted PFZV, ZAV and VEV legal-text copies with different applicant and route scopes

layers.open_gap: Check exact current deadlines and filing triggers against authentic Gazette measures and any EEA/Schengen adaptations.

evidence.representation: official first-step family-reunification form map and visa/representation guidance note

layers.open_gap: Appointment availability, current processing-time service, mission/provider routing and actual application clock trigger remain unverified.

evidence.representation: general administrative procedure text and court reference note

layers.open_gap: No appointment-delay or overdue-decision remedy has been connected to the trigger and route for a specific application.

topics.open_gap: Separate appointment delay from a legal decision clock; establish the event that starts and pauses each period and the available remedy.

topics.label: Personal-data access, minimisation, and separate preservation request

evidence.representation: accepted local public-information law, distinct from personal-data rights; GDPR is separately incorporated in the EEA

layers.open_gap: The source pack identifies the separate Data Protection Act as an open source gap; no local copy or article map states the controller-specific access, correction, restriction, retention or exception rules.
GDPR/JCD 154/2018 is identified at EEA level, but local data-protection implementation and any immigration or law-enforcement processing regime are not retained or mapped.

evidence.representation: official Data Protection Office and complaint guidance reference notes; no Data Protection Act or data-request procedure text is retained

layers.open_gap: Identify controller, purpose, data store, request channel, response time, form, preservation option and applicable exception for each relevant immigration system.

evidence.representation: accepted local general procedure law and official DPA complaint-route guidance note

layers.open_gap: No current source-backed path maps complaint, response deadline, supervisory review and court challenge for a specific data-access decision.

topics.open_gap: Keep public-information access, public-sector information reuse, administrative-file access and GDPR personal-data rights separate. The IWG is a reuse statute, not an access right.
